source.sample: 200 adults age 18–56; standing and supine are separate subjects. Standing male n=73; supine male n=36; four total unknown posture. Moderate/severe degeneration, congenital abnormalities, injuries, surgery and unclear endplates excluded.

angle_semantics: Body: cranial versus caudal endplates of same vertebra; disc: facing endplates of adjacent bodies. Positive lordotic; negative kyphotic.

source_mean_closure.interpretation: Pooled body means and standing disc means are different subsets. Preserve residual; do not force closure or blend source means.

limitations: No stature matching or independent numerical target freeze.
Body and standing disc cohorts differ; SE cannot become individual variation.
